findings.description: The KMS key does not have 'enable_key_rotation = true' set, so automatic annual key rotation is disabled by default, increasing the risk associated with long-lived key material if it is ever compromised.

findings.issue_category: missing key policy / overly permissive default
findings.description: No key_policy is defined for this KMS key, meaning AWS applies the default key policy granting full access (kms:*) to the root account, which can allow any IAM principal with sufficient IAM permissions in the account to use or manage this key, weakening least-privilege control over sensitive audit trail encryption.
